title: Process-template task roles project to KD-05 profiles — a reviewer role without review_target bricks the template
summary: In mission-workflow-catalog default_tasks, team_role reviewer (or any read-only-projected role) with no review_target_suffix expands to a review-kind task that fails validatePlannedNextTasks on every loadAllNextTasks — bricking dispatch for every mission using that template. Delivery/report tasks belong to team_role implementer. Guard: expand the template through expandProcessTemplateTasks + validatePlannedNextTasks in a catalog test before merging a new task.
hint_triggers: When adding a default task to a mission-workflow-catalog template: (1) team_role drives both review-kind classification (reviewer => needs review_target_suffix + REVIEW-<target>.md deliverable) and the delegated KD-05 capability profile (scribe/reviewer/explorer project to read-only profiles that cannot write deliverables); (2) a reviewer task without review_target_suffix throws in expandProcessTemplateTasks and validatePlannedNextTasks, which hard-fails every mission board load for that template; (3) verify new tasks by expanding the real catalog in a test (see mission-workflow-catalog.test.ts expansion case) and checking assigned role + review_target.
